approval.reviewed_by: article author executor (Claude Opus 5.5); not an independent review
approval.checked: test_rmse 0.451 vs train-mean predictor 2.166; train_rmse 0.568 close to the generating noise sd 0.5; two consecutive runs gave identical metrics; 43 test rows were not used for any choice of alpha or features

tolerance_reasons.prediction_atol: Approved test predictions lie between about 1.5 and 10; one float64 ulp there is at most about 1.8e-15. Another BLAS, CPU or summation order may move the last few bits, so exact equality across machines is not promised. 1e-9 leaves about five orders of magnitude for that noise, while a real change such as alpha 1.0 -> 1.01 moves predictions by far more (checked by the tests).
tolerance_reasons.max_test_rmse_ratio: A deliberate model change may cost at most 5% test RMSE. This is a product decision, not a statistical test: with 43 test rows the gate only catches clear degradation, and the test split is evaluated once per proposed candidate.
